stated_text: During the monitoring period, the eGovernment portal was under construction.
summary: Portal under construction during the monitoring period.
note: Needed for the date basis of the null result (finding 9).

stated_text: Findings of this report reflect the period since the publication of the PAR Monitor 2021/2022, starting from the second half of 2022, and until the end of 2024.2
summary: Findings run from the second half of 2022 to the end of 2024.
note: The "2" after 2024 is a footnote mark, kept as printed. Later events are notes made at the time of writing.

stated_text: What can be seen form the services that are available at the moment of writing the report, new portal is improved compared to the previous one.
summary: The improvement in the portal is an observation at the time of writing, from the services then available.
note: "form" as printed. Sets the date basis of item MNE-CSO-2025-001-0019.

stated_text: According to the notice on the portal, the process of collecting and updating data on the availability of e-services is still ongoing.
summary: Data on service availability on the portal were still being collected.
note: Caveat to the improvement in information (finding 34).

stated_text: The latest Report on the Implementation of the Digital Transformation Strategy showed that this Action Plan was not implemented with the desired dynamics, as only 43,14% of planned activities in 2024 were realised.
summary: The monitor repeats the ministry's 43.14% of planned 2024 activities realised.
note: Same figure as MNE-GOV-2025-002-0007, which pass 2 classed out_of_scope under LIM-0026 because it covers the whole strategy, so no issue is proposed here. For the analyst to confirm at G6b.

stated_text: One of the reforms set by the Reform Agenda 23 is delivery of user-friendly digital public services, starting with the creation of the Digital Services Plan for the period 2025-2027.24
summary: The Reform Agenda sets delivery of user-friendly digital public services, starting with the Digital Services Plan 2025-2027.
note: Runs from page 33 to page 34, with footnote 23 and the page header between "Plan" and "for the period"; the sentence is continuous. "23" and "24" are footnote marks, kept as printed. Footnote 23 says the Agenda defines reforms Montenegro must implement to receive money from the European Growth Plan.

stated_text: The e-government users indicator captures the share of individuals who used the internet in the previous 12 months to interact with public authorities.
summary: Defines the e-government users indicator as any interaction with public authorities online.
note: Regional definition used for the Albanian and Montenegrin figures. It does not name a portal.

stated_text: Points under elements 1.10, 2.17 and 3.6 were allocated if all key informants stated that they tend to agree/fully agree with the statement.
summary: Informant points are given only if all informants agree.
note: Runs from page 38 to page 39, with the page header between "2.17" and "and 3.6"; the sentence is continuous.

stated_text: To this end, the work carried out thus far has been guided by Prime Min- ister’s Order No. 72, dated 09.06.2023, which established the inter-institutional working group responsible for reorganizing and digitalizing public services based on the “life-events” model, accessible through the e-Albania portal.
summary: An order of June 2023 established the working group on life events, on the agency's account.
note: From the NAIS reply to a freedom of information request. The stray hyphen comes from the PDF conversion.

stated_text: There are currently overlaps between the two institutions regarding monitoring, evaluation, and reporting, which are counterproductive to an effective service delivery policy.
summary: The overlap the monitor refers to lies between ADISA and the Agency for Dialogue and Co-governance, on monitoring, evaluation and reporting.
note: Text of the earlier recommendation in the table whose status column is item ALB-CSO-2025-001-0076. "The two institutions" are ADISA and the Agency for Dialogue and Co-governance, named in the preceding sentence.

stated_text: The quality and effectiveness of implementation of the public administration reform strategy is improving but not yielding the expected results yet.
summary: The Commission says implementation of the public administration reform strategy is improving but not yet yielding the expected results.
note: Not specific to the portal, so no issue is proposed. Chapter-wide Commission statement on the strategic framework.
